summary.en: Sound is a pressure wave that needs a material medium to travel through, and its intensity — power per unit area — falls off with the square of distance from a point source, which is why loudness drops fast as you move away.
summary.et: Heli on rõhulaine, mis vajab levimiseks ainelist keskkonda, ja selle intensiivsus — võimsus pindalaühiku kohta — kahaneb punktallikast kauguse ruuduga, mistõttu valjus kahaneb kaugenedes kiiresti.
